children: Jaguar Health executed debt-for-equity exchanges with Streeterville to reduce outstanding notes and streamline its capital structure. On September 23, 2026, the company issued 182,091 shares to cut $1,678,320 from its 2021 note and separately issued 547,898 shares to reduce the 2025 note by $5,049,909.26, resulting in that note being fully paid and cancelled. As of September 24, 2026, Jaguar Health reported approximately 1,463,958 shares outstanding.
